entry.title: How many engineers does it take to deprecate a struct?

media:group.media:title: How many engineers does it take to deprecate a struct?
media:group.media:description:
Seems like more than one! Visit cupogo.dev (https://cupogo.dev/) for all the things.
This week: Go 1.27.2 and Go 1.26.9 are released (https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/U2fTuyDJznI) Accepted: add cgo without a C toolchain as a GOEXPERIMENT (and the original one) (https://github.com/golang/go/issues/81662) Accepted: deprecate DNSConfigError (https://github.com/golang/go/issues/63118)
Lightning round: Job with Dave! (https://lnkd.in/p/gtsCwdak) Update on past news: "proposal: spec: allow explicit conversion from function to 1-method interface" Declined (https://github.com/golang/go/issues/47487#issuecomment-4746144126)
